project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components
build_system: No bundler - raw Electron with bundled Lit from assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js
verification_instructions: Verify syntax correctness of all modified JS files using node --check
setup_instructions: No setup needed - just edit files
environment_constraints: No npm, no bundler, Lit imported from local bundled file. Electron main process uses CommonJS require.
key_patterns: Views use LitElement with static styles array including unifiedPageStyles. UI components in src/components/ui/ are custom elements (cd-slider, cd-toggle, cd-select, cd-keybind-input). Main process window logic in src/utils/window.js uses CommonJS.
directory_structure: src/utils/ (main process utilities), src/components/views/ (Lit view components), src/components/ui/ (shared UI components)
